  const char* word
  std::size_t offset

inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, ObservationOutcome value)

inline constexpr bool operator!=(OperatorPageOutcome value, std::string_view name)

inline constexpr bool operator!=(std::string_view name, OperatorPageOutcome value)

struct Question
  std::string asker
  std::string key
  std::map<std::string, std::string> slots
struct Request
  std::string op
  std::optional<Question> ask
  bool wait
  std::string id
  std::string option
  std::string admin
struct Answer
  std::string id
  bool pending
  std::string option
  bool yes
  bool kept
struct RecordMetadata
  std::string id
  std::string asker
  std::string key
  std::string about
  std::string text
  std::vector<std::string> options
  std::string asked
  std::string option
  std::string answered
  bool kept
  bool yes
struct ResponseMetadata
  std::string code
  std::string error
  std::optional<Answer> answer
  std::vector<RecordMetadata> records
struct ApplicationQuestion
  std::string request_key
  std::string key
  std::map<std::string, std::string> slots
struct QuestionObservation
  ObservationOutcome outcome
  std::optional<Answer> answer
struct OperatorPage
  OperatorPageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<RecordMetadata> records
  std::string next
  bool complete
struct OperatorDecision
  OperatorDecisionOutcome outcome
  std::optional<RecordMetadata> record
struct OperatorRetirement
  OperatorRetirementOutcome outcome
  std::optional<RecordMetadata> record
inline std::string encode(const Request& v)
inline Request decode(std::string_view data)
struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error
inline std::string service_name(std::string_view frame)
struct FrameExchanger
  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct QuestionApplication
  virtual QuestionObservation ask(const ApplicationQuestion& question)
  virtual QuestionObservation observe(const std::string& request_key, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
template<class Transport>struct QuestionApplicationClient : QuestionApplication
  Transport& transport_
  QuestionObservation ask(const ApplicationQuestion& question) override
  QuestionObservation observe(const std::string& request_key, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
struct QuestionApplicationService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct QuestionApplicationDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  QuestionApplication& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct QuestionOperator
  virtual OperatorPage list_questions(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual OperatorDecision answer_question(const std::string& id, const std::string& option)
  virtual OperatorRetirement retire_question(const std::string& id)
template<class Transport>struct QuestionOperatorClient : QuestionOperator
  Transport& transport_
  OperatorPage list_questions(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit) override
  OperatorDecision answer_question(const std::string& id, const std::string& option) override
  OperatorRetirement retire_question(const std::string& id) override
struct QuestionOperatorService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct QuestionOperatorDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  QuestionOperator& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
